camel_example: aliyun iot CreateEdgeInstanceMessageRouting --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId nF9oXo7kLRWQ00000000 --SourceType device --TargetType function
description_en: Creates a message route for a specified edge instance
description_zh: 调用该接口，为指定的边缘实例创建消息路由
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-edge-instance-message-routing --instance-id nF9oXo7kLRWQ00000000 --source-type device --target-type function --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEdgeInstanceMessageRouting

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the IoT Platform instance.
Enterprise Enterprise instance: You must specify this parameter. You can view instance ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the Instance Overview page of the IoT Platform console (http://iot.console.aliyun.com/).
Public instance: You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
物联网平台的实例ID：
企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台 (http://iot.console.aliyun.com/)的实例概览页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
公共实例：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The edge instance ID. You can obtain the ID by moving the pointer over the name of the target edge instance on the Edge Instances page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)
parameters.help_zh: 边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the message route. The name must be 4 to 32 characters in length. Each Chinese character or full-width symbol counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh: 消息路由名称。长度限制为4~32个字符，汉字和全角符号算2个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The message filtering condition. Valid values:
A specific message topic: Messages from the message source that match the topic are forwarded to the message receiver. For more information about topics, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html.
all: All messages from the message source are forwarded to the message receiver
parameters.help_zh:
消息过滤条件，取值如下：
具体消息Topic：表示来自消息源，且符合该消息Topic的消息，会被传给消息接收者。Topic相关信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html。
all：表示来自消息源的所有消息，都会被传给消息接收者
parameters.name: topic_filter

parameters.help_en:
The message source. Valid values:
device: Messages are sent by devices.
function: Messages are sent by edge applications.
IotHub: Messages are sent from the cloud
parameters.help_zh:
消息来源，取值如下：
device：表示消息由设备发出。
function：表示消息由边缘应用发出。
IotHub：表示消息由云端发出
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The data of the message source. The value varies based on the following conditions:

If SourceType is set to device: 
    - If a specific device under a specific product sends messages, the format of the value is `/{Your_ProductKey}/{Your_DeviceName}`.

        > Replace {Your_ProductKey} and {Your_DeviceName} with the actual ProductKey and DeviceName of your device.

    - If all devices under a specific product send messages, the format of the value is `/{Your_ProductKey}/+`.

        > Replace {Your_ProductKey} with the actual ProductKey of your product.

    - If all devices under all products in the edge instance send messages, the value is `#`.

If SourceType is set to function: Set this parameter to the ID of the edge application. You can obtain the ID by moving the pointer over the name of the target application on the Applications page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

If SourceType is set to IotHub: You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
消息来源的数据，取值分如下几种情况：

SourceType取值为device时： 
    - 如果由指定产品下的指定设备发送消息，则此处取值格式为`/{Your_ProductKey}/{Your_DeviceName}`。

        > 请将{Your_ProductKey}和{Your_DeviceName}替换为您实际设备的ProductKey和DeviceName。

    - 如果由指定产品下的所有设备发送消息，则此处取值格式为`/{Your_ProductKey}/+`。

        > 请将{Your_ProductKey}替换为您实际设备的ProductKey。

    - 如果由边缘实例中所有产品下的所有设备发送消息，则此处取值为`#`。

SourceType取值为function：此处取值为边缘应用的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的应用管理页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标应用名称上获取ID。

SourceType取值为IotHub时：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: source_data

parameters.help_en:
The message receiver. The value varies based on the following conditions:
If SourceType is set to device: Valid values are function and IotHub. This indicates that messages sent by devices are forwarded to edge applications or the cloud.
If SourceType is set to function: Valid values are function and IotHub. This indicates that messages sent by edge applications are forwarded to other edge applications or the cloud.
If SourceType is set to IotHub: The valid value is function. This indicates that messages sent from the cloud are forwarded to edge applications
parameters.help_zh:
消息接收者，取值分如下几种情况：
SourceType取值为device时：该参数可取的值为function或IotHub，表示由设备发出的消息，传给边缘应用或云端。
SourceType取值为function时：该参数可取的值为function或IotHub，表示由边缘应用发出的消息，传给另一个边缘应用或云端。
SourceType取值为IotHub时：该参数可取的值为function，表示由云端发出的消息，传给边缘应用
parameters.name: target_type

parameters.help_en:
The data of the message receiver. The value varies based on the following conditions:
If TargetType is set to function: Set this parameter to the ID of the edge application. You can obtain the ID by moving the pointer over the name of the target application on the Applications page of the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).
If TargetType is set to IotHub: You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
消息接收者的数据，取值分如下几种情况：
TargetType取值为function时：此处取值为边缘应用的ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的应用管理页面中，鼠标指针悬浮在目标应用名称上获取ID。
TargetType取值为IotHub时：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: target_data

parameters.help_en:
The quality of service (QoS) level. Valid values:

0: A message is sent only once, regardless of whether it is successfully received by the message receiver.

1: A message is sent at least once until an acknowledgment is received from the message receiver.

If TargetType is set to IoTHub, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
服务级别。取值如下：

0：表示消息仅发送一次，不管是否被消息接收者成功接收。

1：表示最少发送一次消息，直至收到消息接收者的返回信息，则停止发送该消息。

当TargetType为IoTHub时，必须传入此参数
parameters.name: target_iot_hub_qos

Success：表示成功。
其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

true：表示调用成功。
